scope: QUIC v1 binary header fields, independently owned ranges, real zero-CID tuple reuse, public full-export invariants and actual Windows console pages. No claim of complete QUIC/TLS/HTTP3 coverage or authenticated peers.
implementation: raw owned binary DCID/SCID/token instead of lossy UTF8 strings
literal long-header/known-context short-header typed fields with PDU spans
decoded packet numbers require private authenticated native evidence and have no literal ciphertext value span
empty long CID is present and distinct from absent short Version/SCID/lengths
uniquely protected packet selects competing zero-CID tuple generations even if close is lost
failed/ambiguous ownership does not borrow a flow or transaction; late closed packets do not renew key leases
catalog_scope: partial: v1 native transport; v2 selected bin-parser layout only, no v2 native authentication/ingress; wider token-varint rule profile and remaining protocol conformance unselected

header_audit.scope:
Bind QUIC CID/version/decoded-PN projections to native PDU bytes and TShark.
Clear header fields do not prove a sender. Decoded packet numbers are separately
gated by native authentication and compared with the reference when available.
Unmatched/derived reference views stay visible rather than becoming matches.

SDK_invariants.scope:
Constrain complete exports to the reviewed QUIC binary/header projection.
Every raw PDU, packet, flow, transaction, application frame and byte source must
stay identical. Exact header values/ranges are separately checked on wire by
quic_header_wire_audit.py; this comparison never declares field parity itself.

source_graph_audit.scope:
Independently verify native HTTP/3 byte witnesses against reference STREAMs.
Scope: owned, single-UDP-view capture; complete bidi HTTP streams and uni control
streams. Encoder/decoder instruction semantics and peer identity are not certified.

negative_controls.scope:
Require QUIC header/epoch audit to reject deliberately corrupted exports.
Uses the original real capture and reference, then mutates one evidence item.
Full captures, manifests, oracle output and mutated JSONL stay outside Git.

new_real_zero_CID.reference_probe_policy: TShark DecodeAs classifies capture-ready nonce datagrams as QUIC candidates without a decoded number; native keeps them unknown UDP. All 106 reference-decoded packets covered, plus eight separately diagnosed unprotected zero tails.
